To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a small number of dedicated faculty members, with the support of their administration, can make a significant difference in the culture of undergraduate research; 2) the key to success is to start small and build on success; and 3) the key to sustainability is to develop a culture of student and faculty engagement in undergraduate research.

1) a small group of dedicated faculty and staff can make a significant impact in institutionalizing undergraduate research at an institution of higher education; 2) a small group can make a significant and lasting impact on the undergraduate research program of an institution by applying classic group theory to its work; 3) a small group that is dedicated to the success of its institution’s undergraduate research program can have a significant impact on student learning and student engagement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How do faculty and administrators at a small, public, predominantly undergraduate university move the needle of research participation from a few to many?
how to create a culture of undergraduate research and the role of the undergraduate research director in the process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
undergraduate research has the power to transform the culture of a college campus.
undergraduate research at Georgia College has become institutionalized and sustainable.
we are on the right track.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we started with an idea, a few faculty, a few students, and a small grant.
we have moved from a set of disparate undergraduate research activities to the development of a full time undergraduate research director and a budget of $200,000 in two years.
we have moved from an ad-hoc, uncoordinated approach to an institutionalized approach to undergraduate research.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a small, dedicated group of individuals, with the right skills, can move the needle in undergraduate research.
the process of building a culture of undergraduate research at Georgia College is a work in progress.
a small group of dedicated faculty members, with a common vision and purpose, can achieve significant results in a short time frame.
